rating.label: Scale
rating.description: A rating on a scale, like 1 to 5.

open_text.label: Open-ended
open_text.description: A free answer in one sentence.

quiz.label: Quiz
quiz.description: A question with a correct answer and points.

ranking.label: Ranking
ranking.description: The audience ranks the options by preference.

points_100.label: 100 points
points_100.description: Each person splits 100 points across the options.

matrix_2x2.label: 2×2 matrix
matrix_2x2.description: Each person places the items on two axes, like effort × impact.

pin_image.label: Pin on image
pin_image.description: Each person taps a spot on the image; the big screen shows a heat map.

guess_number.label: Guess the number
guess_number.description: Each person guesses a number; the closest guesses earn the most points.

quiz_text.label: Type-answer quiz
quiz_text.description: People type the answer; spelling variations still count as correct.

content.label: Content slide
content.description: Title, text, image, or video on the big screen, with no answers.

scale.label: 1–5 scale
scale.description: Buttons from 1 to 5 with labels at each end.

nps.label: 0–10 score
nps.description: NPS style: the report calculates promoters and detractors.

text.label: Free text
text.description: Open answer, included in the AI analysis.

survey.label: People who answer the survey
survey.description: When someone submits the post-event survey, they get a number. People who don't answer aren't entered.

everyone.label: Everyone who joins the session
everyone.description: Everyone gets a number when they join, even without answering the survey.
